title: Verification evidence schemas
responsibility: Defines validated captures, measurements, component identities, budget findings and complete verification records.

outputs.name: captureSchema
outputs.description: Zod strict-object schema for validating one artifact capture attached to a verification state. It requires identifier-valued evidence and state, kind screenshot/audio/output/assertions/trace/benchmark, status passed/failed, nonempty path/mediaType/capturedAt, a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256, and nonnegative integer bytes; optional clip uses nonnegative integer x/y and positive integer width/height, optional durationSeconds is positive, and optional server.revision is a 40-character lowercase commit or tree hash.

outputs.name: scenarioResultSchema
outputs.description: Zod strict-object schema for one scenario's result and evidence states when recording scenario verification. It requires an identifier, status passed/failed/referenced, a 40-character lowercase testedRevision hash, and states containing an identifier, coverage required/missing/inapplicable, and captures validated by captureSchema; optional referencedRecord is nonempty and optional reason is a string.

outputs.name: profileSchema
outputs.description: Zod strict-object schema for the machine and runtime profile associated with verification or measurement evidence. It requires nonempty id, platform, arch, cpu, and runtime strings plus positive integer cores and memoryBytes.

outputs.name: budgetFindingSchema
outputs.description: Zod strict-object schema for one metric's budget comparison or explicit measurement state when reporting verification budgets. It requires an identifier-valued unit, nonempty metric, one of passed/exceeded/missing-baseline/missing-measurement/incomplete/incompatible/unavailable, and nullable numeric baseline and measured values; target is optional and limited to runtimeKinds, while optional differences is an array of nonempty strings.

outputs.name: componentVersionSchema
outputs.description: Zod strict-object schema for the exact version of a unit observed in a verification record. It requires an identifier-valued unit, change unchanged/modified/added/removed, a target from runtimeKinds, four 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digests, and files whose nonempty paths have 40-character lowercase commit or tree hashes.

outputs.name: measurementSchema
outputs.description: Zod strict-object schema for one measured metric or an explicit unavailable measurement in a verification record. It requires an identifier-valued unit, nonempty metric/unitOfMeasure/method, numeric or null value, nullable identifier workload and string profile, a 40-character lowercase testedRevision hash, and artifacts with nonempty paths, 64-character lowercase SHA-256 hashes, and nonnegative integer byte counts; optional samples must be positive, optional target comes from runtimeKinds, and optional comparison is validated by comparisonSchema.

outputs.name: verificationRecordSchema
outputs.description: Zod strict-object schema for validating a complete verification record against its source revision, profile, evidence, and gates. It fixes schemaVersion at 1, permits optional componentSchemaVersion 2, requires source commit/tree and tested revisions to be 40-character lowercase hashes, requires a profile and the components, measurements, impact, tests, scenarios, budgets, reasons, and failures sections, and constrains status values and nested objects as declared by their schemas; tools, builds, gates, and componentSchemaVersion are optional, and test browserErrors is an optional array validated by browserDiagnosticSchema.
